failures: Fresh setup exposed public SSH submodule URLs and an incomplete dependency checkout; fixed HTTPS/pinned checkout bootstrap.
Source archive included AppleDouble metadata, causing the foundation check to fail; replaced with clean archive.
Prime validation mutated the input config before TOML serialization; validation now uses a deep copy.
Local judge SSH needed the owned node host key pinned before connection.
First native launch initialized inference but wrapper parsed Prime's JSON child configuration as TOML; fixed and tested both formats.
Restart initially collided with the failed run directory; preserved that directory and restarted under a clean output directory.

Restart reached initialized trainer and all 2486 tasks, but VF task transport deserialized NativePaintingRLTask.data into NativePaintingData, dropping opponent fields. Every request failed and the zero-output guard stopped the run; no rollout reached the judge and no optimizer update occurred.

Student generation produced at least 84 canvases, but frozen baseline VF requests were rejected by Prime router8000 because reasoning_effort=none is outside its schema. Fourteen failed traces were observed, excluded from rewards. Stopped owned run; direct vLLM endpoint8100 accepted identical one-token request. Restart uses that endpoint; all attempt artifacts retained, no optimizer update verified.
limitations: Rented hardware before preparation was complete; roughly an hour of rental passed without optimizer work.
